verdict.rationale: a-Shell's source is hosted publicly on GitHub (github.com/holzschu/a-shell), which strongly implies the code is readable and available for inspection, satisfying part of the openness story. However, the evidence pack never states an explicit open-source license (e.g., MIT, GPL) or points to a LICENSE file, so the 'open license' claim is not directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit license identification, confirmation of license terms/permissions, and any independent corroboration of licensing status.
